provenance.note: Sniper rifles of an army, police or customs introduced at any date, with a bipod allowed; split into ZG 1 mod. B1 (before 1 January 1965) and B2 (after) where needed. D.11.16 restates no distance, the record takes the 100 m of ZG 1 (D.11.13). Only the weapon rule deviates from ZG 1 (D.11.16); the other rules are read from ZG 1. Sighters and times are not set because the target plan differs.
